entities.name: Borico Gavish
entities.description: A noble on Shandalar, son of the lord of a castle.

entities.name: Gwaro
entities.description: Court troubadour who told Borico a story of the armor's origins.

entities.name: Kray
entities.description: The castle's man-at-arms who offered another origin story.

entities.name: Leore the Dragonslayer
entities.description: Said to have owned the armor and been able to walk through dragon fire.

entities.name: Xathrid necromancer
entities.description: Necromancer who slew the lord, lady and knights of the castle, and was slain by the brother's spirit.

entities.name: Haunted Plate Mail
entities.description: Well-crafted armor in the Gavish castle crypt with a darkness inside its visor.

entities.name: Age of Strife
entities.description: Era when evil beset the land.

events.summary: Borico seeks the crypt's coolness and stands before a suit of armor with an unlit darkness in the visor.
events.quote: He stood in awe in front of a particularly well-crafted suit of armor.

events.summary: Gwaro tells that the lord, lady and knights were slain by a Xathrid necromancer in the Age of Strife.
events.quote: the lord and lady of their castle and all their knights were slain by the necromancer on the field of battle

events.summary: In the story, the sister is undead after entering the lair and kills her brother with her sword.
events.quote: She pulled the sword from her body and killed her brother with it.

events.summary: In the story, the brother rises as a fearless spirit in the armor, slays the necromancer, and rests in the crypt.
events.quote: the noble ghost charged into the necromancer's castle and slew him

events.summary: Kray offers another origin: forged by demons and blessed by angels.
events.quote: it was forged by demons and blessed by angels

relations.note: court troubadour of his father's castle
relations.quote: The court troubadour Gwaro approached Borico
